title: RiX bounded optimization mixed-integer-result v1
description: Normalized semantic record before mathematical JSON tagging (RiX map keys are case-insensitive). Exact scalars, Shaped values, expression graphs and LP records use the shared codec. A schema match never certifies a claim; invoke the bounded replay checker. See plugins/optimize/tutorial.md for algorithm/work limits.
